subject.title: Dashboard: full-bleed tab layout + "tab app" bundle

question: Should OpenClaw accept full-bleed tab-app layout as bundled dashboard work after the modular-dashboard base lands, or should the tab-app bundle pattern stay external until the sandbox and storage model is approved?
rationale: The requested feature is plausible Control UI ergonomics work, but it changes a default-facing dashboard surface and relies on security-sensitive custom-widget behavior that automation cannot product-approve.

options.title: Keep As Gated Wave 2 Work
options.body: Keep this issue open as the focused full-bleed/tab-app follow-up and require the Wave 1 dashboard PRs plus storage and sandbox decisions to settle first.

options.title: Prove Bundle Pattern Externally
options.body: Ask contributors to validate tab-app bundle conventions as an external plugin or ClawHub package while OpenClaw only exposes missing generic seams.

options.title: Pause Dashboard Apps Layer
options.body: Defer or close the apps-layer direction if maintainers do not want bundled dashboard app surfaces in the current product cycle.

recommendation.title: Keep As Gated Wave 2 Work
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the focused full-bleed/tab-app follow-up and require the Wave 1 dashboard PRs plus storage and sandbox decisions to settle first.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history signal for the Control UI plugin-tab seam and bundled dashboard product direction.
